```{r functions, include=FALSE}

ppm_diff <- function(mz1, mz2) {
  abs(mz1 - mz2) / mz1 * 1e6
}

# CCS difference in percent; NA when either CCS is missing or 0 (not measured)
ccs_diff <- function(ccs1, ccs2) {
  out <- abs(ccs1 - ccs2) / ccs1 * 100
  out[is.na(ccs1) | is.na(ccs2) | ccs1 <= 0 | ccs2 <= 0 | !is.finite(out)] <- NA_real_
  out
}

# Sample key of a column name: strips the "datafile." prefix and the
# ".d" / ".mzML" suffix including anything after it (".area", ".height", ...)
sample_key <- function(cn) {
  sub("\\.(d|mzML)(\\..*)?$", "", sub("^datafile\\.", "", cn))
}

# NA-aware equality: TRUE when both are NA or both are equal
same_val <- function(a, b) {
  (is.na(a) & is.na(b)) | (!is.na(a) & !is.na(b) & a == b)
}

# Clean up peaktable by removing near-duplicate features
# Identified features: grouped by identity string
# Unknown features: grouped by mz, rt
# Within each group the rows with the top 2 highest mean intensity are kept
remove_dup <- function(df, thres_mz_ppm = 3, thres_rt_min = 0.1) {
  n <- nrow(df)
  if (n == 0L) return(df)

  int_cols <- get_sample_cols(df)
  mean_int <- if (length(int_cols) > 0L)
    rowMeans(as.matrix(df[, int_cols, drop = FALSE]), na.rm = TRUE)
  else
    rep(0, n)

  has_id <- !is.na(df$identity)

  # Identified features: keep top 2
  keep_id <- integer(0)
  if (any(has_id)) {
    idx_id  <- which(has_id)
    keep_id <- unlist(
      tapply(idx_id, df$identity[idx_id],
             function(rows) rows[order(mean_int[rows], decreasing = TRUE)[seq_len(min(2L, length(rows)))]]),
      use.names = FALSE
    )
  }

  # Unknown features: keep top 2
  keep_unk <- integer(0)
  if (any(!has_id)) {
    idx_unk <- which(!has_id)
    m       <- length(idx_unk)

    ord  <- order(df$mz[idx_unk])
    mz_s <- df$mz[idx_unk[ord]]
    rt_s <- df$rt[idx_unk[ord]]

    parent <- seq_len(m)
    find_root <- function(x) {
      while (parent[x] != x) { parent[x] <<- parent[parent[x]]; x <- parent[x] }
      x
    }
    union_nodes <- function(x, y) {
      rx <- find_root(x); ry <- find_root(y)
      if (rx != ry) parent[ry] <<- rx
    }

    for (i in seq_len(m - 1L)) {
      lo <- findInterval(mz_s[i] * (1 - thres_mz_ppm * 1e-6), mz_s) + 1L
      hi <- findInterval(mz_s[i] * (1 + thres_mz_ppm * 1e-6), mz_s)
      if (hi < max(lo, i + 1L)) next
      js <- seq.int(max(lo, i + 1L), hi)
      js <- js[abs(rt_s[js] - rt_s[i]) < thres_rt_min]
      for (j in js) union_nodes(i, j)
    }

    roots        <- vapply(seq_len(m), find_root, integer(1L))
    groups       <- integer(m)
    groups[ord]  <- roots
    local_keep   <- unlist(
      tapply(seq_len(m), groups,
             function(k) k[order(mean_int[idx_unk[k]], decreasing = TRUE)[seq_len(min(2L, length(k)))]]),
      use.names = FALSE
    )
    keep_unk <- idx_unk[local_keep]
  }

  df[sort(c(keep_id, keep_unk)), , drop = FALSE]
}

# Return intensity columns
get_sample_cols <- function(df) {
  cn <- colnames(df)
  if (any(grepl("\\.d\\.area$", cn))) return(grep("\\.d\\.area$", cn, value = TRUE))
  if (any(grepl("\\.area$",    cn))) return(grep("\\.area$",    cn, value = TRUE))
  if (any(grepl("(?<!\\.rt|\\.mz)\\.d$", cn, perl = TRUE)))
    return(grep("(?<!\\.rt|\\.mz)\\.d$", cn, value = TRUE, perl = TRUE))
  grep("\\.mzML$", cn, value = TRUE)
}

# Assign overlap samples to the orginal sequence
build_overlap_assignment <- function(master_meta, batch_metas) {
  if (is.null(master_meta) || !"Sample" %in% colnames(master_meta)) return(NULL)
  n_b <- length(batch_metas)
  if (n_b == 0L) return(NULL)

  all_batch_samples <- lapply(batch_metas, function(m) {
    if (is.null(m) || !"Sample" %in% colnames(m)) character(0L) else m$Sample
  })

  freq          <- table(unlist(all_batch_samples))
  overlap_samps <- names(freq)[freq >= n_b]
  if (length(overlap_samps) == 0L) return(NULL)

  specific_samps <- lapply(all_batch_samples, function(s) s[!s %in% overlap_samps])

  pos_of <- setNames(seq_along(master_meta$Sample), master_meta$Sample)

  batch_ranges <- lapply(specific_samps, function(sp) {
    p <- pos_of[sp[sp %in% names(pos_of)]]
    if (length(p) == 0L) return(c(NA_integer_, NA_integer_))
    c(min(p), max(p))
  })

  assignment <- vapply(overlap_samps, function(s) {
    p <- pos_of[[s]]
    if (is.null(p) || is.na(p)) return(1L)
    dists <- vapply(batch_ranges, function(r) {
      if (anyNA(r)) return(Inf)
      if (p >= r[1L] && p <= r[2L]) return(0)
      as.numeric(min(abs(p - r[1L]), abs(p - r[2L])))
    }, numeric(1L))
    which.min(dists)
  }, integer(1L))

  setNames(assignment, overlap_samps)
}

# Translate a Sample -> batch assignment into a sample key -> batch assignment
# (sample key = make.names(File.name) without ".d"/".mzML", matching sample_key())
assignment_to_keys <- function(assignment, meta) {
  if (is.null(assignment) || is.null(meta) ||
      !all(c("Sample", "File.name") %in% colnames(meta))) return(NULL)
  fn   <- meta$File.name[match(names(assignment), meta$Sample)]
  ok   <- !is.na(fn)
  keys <- sub("\\.(d|mzML)$", "", make.names(fn[ok]))
  setNames(assignment[ok], keys)
}

# Estimate the systematic m/z (ppm) and RT (min) offset of df relative to ref,
# using features annotated exactly once in each table (same identity/ion/formula)
estimate_batch_shift <- function(ref, df, min_anchors = 20L, rt_win = 0.3) {
  key  <- function(x) paste(x$identity, x$ion, x$formula, sep = "|")
  uniq <- function(x) {
    x <- x[!is.na(x$identity), c("mz", "rt", "identity", "ion", "formula"), drop = FALSE]
    k <- key(x)
    x[!(duplicated(k) | duplicated(k, fromLast = TRUE)), , drop = FALSE]
  }
  a  <- uniq(ref)
  b  <- uniq(df)
  m  <- match(key(a), key(b))
  ok <- !is.na(m)
  a  <- a[ok, , drop = FALSE]
  b  <- b[m[ok], , drop = FALSE]
  keep <- abs(a$rt - b$rt) < rt_win
  a  <- a[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  b  <- b[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  n  <- nrow(a)
  if (n < min_anchors) return(list(ppm = 0, rt = 0, n = n, applied = FALSE))
  list(
    ppm     = stats::median((b$mz - a$mz) / a$mz * 1e6),
    rt      = stats::median(b$rt - a$rt),
    n       = n,
    applied = TRUE
  )
}

# Align features from two peaktables
# shift_ppm / shift_rt: systematic offset of df2 relative to df1, removed before matching
# best_match = TRUE: keeps the best-scoring match per df1 feature
# thres_cor / thres_log2ratio: NA disables the filter
# prefer_df2_keys: sample keys whose columns are taken from df2 when both tables have them
align_features <- function(df1, df2, thres_mz_ppm = 3, thres_rt_min = 0.1, best_match = TRUE,
                           thres_cor = 0.7, thres_log2ratio = 0.3,
                           shift_ppm = 0, shift_rt = 0,
                           prefer_df2_keys = character(0),
                           step_label = "") {

  funnel <- c(ref_features = nrow(df1), batch_features = nrow(df2),
              mz_rt_match = 0L, id_ok = 0L, cor_ok = 0L, log2ratio_ok = 0L, merged = 0L)
  empty  <- function() list(merged = NULL, diag = NULL, l2r_long = NULL, funnel = funnel)
  n_feat <- function(p) length(unique(p$.i))

  ccs_flag  <- "ccs" %in% colnames(df1) && "ccs" %in% colnames(df2)
  meta_cols <- c("mz", "rt", "identity", "ion", "formula", if (ccs_flag) "ccs")

  m1 <- cbind(.i = seq_len(nrow(df1)), df1[, meta_cols, drop = FALSE])
  m2 <- cbind(.j = seq_len(nrow(df2)), df2[, meta_cols, drop = FALSE])

  # Remove the systematic batch offset from df2 (matching coordinates only)
  m2$mz <- m2$mz / (1 + shift_ppm * 1e-6)
  m2$rt <- m2$rt - shift_rt

  # Candidate pairs within the m/z and RT windows (m2 sorted by mz)
  m2s      <- m2[order(m2$mz), , drop = FALSE]
  pair_idx <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(m1)), function(i) {
    mz1 <- m1$mz[i]
    lo  <- findInterval(mz1 * (1 - thres_mz_ppm * 1e-6), m2s$mz) + 1L
    hi  <- findInterval(mz1 * (1 + thres_mz_ppm * 1e-6), m2s$mz)
    if (lo > hi) return(NULL)
    rt_ok <- which(abs(m2s$rt[lo:hi] - m1$rt[i]) < thres_rt_min) + (lo - 1L)
    if (length(rt_ok) == 0) return(NULL)
    list(i = rep(i, length(rt_ok)), j = rt_ok)
  })
  pair_idx <- Filter(Negate(is.null), pair_idx)
  if (length(pair_idx) == 0) return(empty())

  all_i <- unlist(lapply(pair_idx, `[[`, "i"))
  all_j <- m2s$.j[unlist(lapply(pair_idx, `[[`, "j"))]

  pairs <- data.frame(
    .i = all_i, .j = all_j,
    mz.1 = m1$mz[all_i], rt.1 = m1$rt[all_i],
    identity.1 = m1$identity[all_i], ion.1 = m1$ion[all_i], formula.1 = m1$formula[all_i],
    mz.2 = m2$mz[all_j], rt.2 = m2$rt[all_j],
    identity.2 = m2$identity[all_j], ion.2 = m2$ion[all_j], formula.2 = m2$formula[all_j],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  pairs$mz_ppm  <- ppm_diff(pairs$mz.1, pairs$mz.2)
  pairs$rt_diff <- abs(pairs$rt.1 - pairs$rt.2)
  if (ccs_flag) {
    pairs$ccs.1       <- m1$ccs[all_i]
    pairs$ccs.2       <- m2$ccs[all_j]
    pairs$ccs_percent <- ccs_diff(pairs$ccs.1, pairs$ccs.2)
  }

  pairs <- pairs[pairs$mz_ppm < thres_mz_ppm & pairs$rt_diff < thres_rt_min, , drop = FALSE]
  funnel["mz_rt_match"] <- n_feat(pairs)
  if (nrow(pairs) == 0) return(empty())

  # Identified df1 features must match an identical annotation in df2
  has_id <- !is.na(pairs$identity.1)
  id_ok  <- !is.na(pairs$identity.2) &
    same_val(pairs$identity.1, pairs$identity.2) &
    same_val(pairs$ion.1,      pairs$ion.2) &
    same_val(pairs$formula.1,  pairs$formula.2)
  pairs <- pairs[!has_id | id_ok, , drop = FALSE]
  funnel["id_ok"] <- n_feat(pairs)
  if (nrow(pairs) == 0) return(empty())

  sample_cols <- intersect(get_sample_cols(df1), get_sample_cols(df2))
  use_quality <- length(sample_cols) > 2

  if (use_quality) {
    L1 <- log2(pmax(as.matrix(df1[pairs$.i, sample_cols, drop = FALSE]), 1))
    L2 <- log2(pmax(as.matrix(df2[pairs$.j, sample_cols, drop = FALSE]), 1))
    l2r_raw <- L1 - L2

    # Per-sample intensity offset between the batches, estimated from pairs where
    # both sides are detected, and removed before scoring
    det <- L1 > 0 & L2 > 0
    det[is.na(det)] <- FALSE
    l2r_det <- l2r_raw
    l2r_det[!det] <- NA_real_
    offset <- apply(l2r_det, 2, stats::median, na.rm = TRUE)
    offset[!is.finite(offset)] <- 0
    l2r_c <- sweep(l2r_raw, 2, offset)
    L2c   <- sweep(L2,      2, offset, FUN = "+")

    pairs$score     <- apply(l2r_c,   1, stats::median, na.rm = TRUE)
    pairs$score_raw <- apply(l2r_raw, 1, stats::median, na.rm = TRUE)
    pairs$r_spear   <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(pairs)), function(k) {
      r <- suppressWarnings(stats::cor(L1[k, ], L2c[k, ], method = "spearman",
                                       use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
      if (is.na(r)) 0 else r
    }, numeric(1))
    pairs$mean_int <- rowMeans(cbind(L1, L2), na.rm = TRUE)

    if (!is.na(thres_cor)) pairs <- pairs[pairs$r_spear > thres_cor, , drop = FALSE]
    funnel["cor_ok"] <- n_feat(pairs)
    if (!is.na(thres_log2ratio))
      pairs <- pairs[!is.na(pairs$score) & abs(pairs$score) < thres_log2ratio, , drop = FALSE]
    funnel["log2ratio_ok"] <- n_feat(pairs)
    if (nrow(pairs) == 0) return(empty())

    if (best_match) {
      pairs <- pairs[order(pairs$.i, -pairs$mean_int), , drop = FALSE]
      pairs <- pairs[!duplicated(pairs$.i), , drop = FALSE]
    }
  } else {
    funnel["cor_ok"]       <- n_feat(pairs)
    funnel["log2ratio_ok"] <- n_feat(pairs)
    if (best_match) {
      # No shared samples: keep the closest candidate in m/z + RT
      dist  <- pairs$mz_ppm / thres_mz_ppm + pairs$rt_diff / thres_rt_min
      pairs <- pairs[order(pairs$.i, dist), , drop = FALSE]
      pairs <- pairs[!duplicated(pairs$.i), , drop = FALSE]
    }
  }

  # Build merged table: feature metadata from df1, sample columns from both.
  # Columns present in both tables are kept once (from df1), except samples
  # assigned to df2's batch, which are taken from df2.
  out1   <- df1[pairs$.i, , drop = FALSE]
  out2   <- df2[pairs$.j, , drop = FALSE]
  shared <- intersect(colnames(out1), colnames(out2))
  take2  <- shared[sample_key(shared) %in% prefer_df2_keys]
  if (length(take2) > 0) out1[take2] <- out2[take2]
  out2   <- out2[, setdiff(colnames(out2), colnames(out1)), drop = FALSE]
  merged_wide <- cbind(out1, out2)
  rownames(merged_wide) <- NULL
  funnel["merged"] <- nrow(merged_wide)

  # Diagnostics
  if (use_quality) {
    mat1_fin <- as.matrix(df1[pairs$.i, sample_cols, drop = FALSE])
    mat2_fin <- as.matrix(df2[pairs$.j, sample_cols, drop = FALSE])
    ovlp_cor <- pairs$r_spear
    ratio    <- mat1_fin / mat2_fin
    ratio[ratio <= 0] <- NA_real_
    l2r_mat  <- log2(ratio)
    med_l2r  <- apply(l2r_mat, 1, stats::median, na.rm = TRUE)
    med_l2r_c <- pairs$score
    id_vec   <- if (!is.null(df1$identity)) df1$identity[pairs$.i] else rep(NA_character_, nrow(l2r_mat))
    samp_vec <- sample_key(colnames(l2r_mat))
    l2r_long <- data.frame(
      step      = rep(step_label, nrow(l2r_mat) * ncol(l2r_mat)),
      identity  = rep(id_vec,     ncol(l2r_mat)),
      sample    = rep(samp_vec,   each = nrow(l2r_mat)),
      log2ratio = as.vector(l2r_mat),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    l2r_long <- l2r_long[is.finite(l2r_long$log2ratio), , drop = FALSE]
  } else {
    ovlp_cor  <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(pairs))
    med_l2r   <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(pairs))
    med_l2r_c <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(pairs))
    l2r_long  <- NULL
  }

  diag <- data.frame(
    step             = step_label,
    mz               = df1$mz[pairs$.i],
    rt               = df1$rt[pairs$.i],
    identity         = if (!is.null(df1$identity)) df1$identity[pairs$.i] else NA_character_,
    mz_ppm           = pairs$mz_ppm,
    rt_diff          = pairs$rt_diff,
    overlap_cor      = ovlp_cor,
    median_log2ratio = med_l2r,
    median_log2ratio_centered = med_l2r_c,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  if (ccs_flag) {
    diag$ccs         <- df1$ccs[pairs$.i]
    diag$ccs_percent <- pairs$ccs_percent
  }

  list(merged = merged_wide, diag = diag, l2r_long = l2r_long, funnel = funnel)
}

# Cleanup
clean_merged <- function(df) {
  df[, !colnames(df) %in% c("mz_batch_diff", "rt_batch_diff"), drop = FALSE]
}

# Iteratively align a list of peaktables (all batches matched in b1 coordinates)
merge_table_list <- function(tables, label,
                             thres_mz_ppm = 3, thres_rt_min = 0.1, best_match = TRUE,
                             thres_cor = 0.7, thres_log2ratio = 0.3,
                             shift_correction = TRUE, overlap_col_assignment = NULL,
                             shifts = NULL) {
  tables <- Filter(Negate(is.null), tables)
  # Precomputed per-batch shifts (e.g. from the main table, for ISTD tables) are
  # only used when they line up with the available batches
  if (!is.null(shifts) && length(shifts) != length(tables)) shifts <- NULL
  if (length(tables) == 0) return(NULL)

  input_counts <- data.frame(
    table    = label,
    label    = paste0("b", seq_along(tables), " (input)"),
    features = vapply(tables, nrow, integer(1)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  if (length(tables) == 1) {
    return(list(merged = tables[[1]], diag = NULL, counts = NULL, l2r_long = NULL,
                funnel = NULL, shifts = NULL, input_counts = input_counts,
                n_final = nrow(tables[[1]])))
  }

  diag_list   <- vector("list", length(tables) - 1)
  count_list  <- vector("list", length(tables) - 1)
  l2r_list    <- vector("list", length(tables) - 1)
  funnel_list <- vector("list", length(tables) - 1)
  shift_list  <- c(list(list(ppm = 0, rt = 0, n = NA_integer_, applied = FALSE)),
                   vector("list", length(tables) - 1))

  current <- remove_dup(tables[[1]], thres_mz_ppm = thres_mz_ppm, thres_rt_min = thres_rt_min)

  for (k in seq(2, length(tables))) {
    n_before <- nrow(current)
    step_lbl <- paste0("b", k - 1, "→b", k)

    shift <- if (!shift_correction) list(ppm = 0, rt = 0, n = NA_integer_, applied = FALSE)
             else if (!is.null(shifts) && isTRUE(shifts[[k]]$applied)) shifts[[k]]
             else estimate_batch_shift(tables[[1]], tables[[k]])
    shift_list[[k]] <- shift

    prefer_keys <- if (is.null(overlap_col_assignment)) character(0)
                   else names(overlap_col_assignment)[overlap_col_assignment == k]

    res <- align_features(current,
                          remove_dup(tables[[k]], thres_mz_ppm = thres_mz_ppm, thres_rt_min = thres_rt_min),
                          thres_mz_ppm = thres_mz_ppm, thres_rt_min = thres_rt_min,
                          best_match = best_match,
                          thres_cor = thres_cor, thres_log2ratio = thres_log2ratio,
                          shift_ppm = shift$ppm, shift_rt = shift$rt,
                          prefer_df2_keys = prefer_keys,
                          step_label = step_lbl)
    if (is.null(res$merged) || nrow(res$merged) == 0)
      stop("Feature alignment returned 0 rows for ", label, " at batch ", k)

    current <- clean_merged(res$merged)
    message(label, ": +b", k, "  ", n_before, " + ", nrow(tables[[k]]),
            " -> ", nrow(current), " features",
            sprintf("  (shift vs b1: %+.2f ppm, %+.3f min, %s anchors%s)",
                    shift$ppm, shift$rt, shift$n, if (shift$applied) "" else ", not applied"))

    if (!is.null(res$diag))
      diag_list[[k - 1]] <- cbind(table = label, res$diag, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    count_list[[k - 1]] <- data.frame(
      table    = label,
      step     = step_lbl,
      n_before = n_before,
      n_batch  = nrow(tables[[k]]),
      n_merged = nrow(current),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    funnel_list[[k - 1]] <- data.frame(
      table     = label,
      step      = step_lbl,
      shift_ppm = round(shift$ppm, 2),
      shift_rt  = round(shift$rt, 3),
      anchors   = shift$n,
      t(res$funnel),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    if (!is.null(res$l2r_long) && nrow(res$l2r_long) > 0)
      l2r_list[[k - 1]] <- cbind(table = label, res$l2r_long, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }

  list(
    merged       = current,
    diag         = do.call(rbind, Filter(Negate(is.null), diag_list)),
    counts       = do.call(rbind, count_list),
    funnel       = do.call(rbind, funnel_list),
    shifts       = shift_list,
    l2r_long     = {
      non_null <- Filter(function(x) !is.null(x) && nrow(x) > 0, l2r_list)
      if (length(non_null) > 0) do.call(rbind, non_null) else NULL
    },
    input_counts = input_counts,
    n_final      = nrow(current)
  )
}

# Numeric threshold from config: blank -> default; "none"/"off"/no -> NA (filter disabled)
cfg_threshold <- function(x, default) {
  if (wf_is_blank(x)) return(default)
  if (is.logical(x)) return(if (isTRUE(x)) default else NA_real_)
  v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x[1]))
  if (is.na(v)) NA_real_ else v
}
```

## Inputs

```{r inputs}

cfg     <- wf_read_yaml_config(params$config, label = "params$config")
run.pos <- wf_as_flag(cfg$run.pos)
run.neg <- wf_as_flag(cfg$run.neg)
n_batches <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(cfg$n_batches))

thres_mz_ppm     <- cfg_threshold(cfg$thres_mz_ppm, 3)
thres_rt_min     <- cfg_threshold(cfg$thres_rt_min, 0.1)
thres_cor        <- cfg_threshold(cfg$thres_cor, 0.7)
thres_log2ratio  <- cfg_threshold(cfg$thres_log2ratio, 0.3)
best_match       <- if (wf_is_blank(cfg$best_match)) TRUE else wf_as_flag(cfg$best_match)
shift_correction <- if (wf_is_blank(cfg$shift_correction)) TRUE else wf_as_flag(cfg$shift_correction)

if (is.na(thres_mz_ppm) || is.na(thres_rt_min))
  stop("thres_mz_ppm and thres_rt_min must be numeric")
if (is.na(n_batches) || n_batches < 2)
  stop("n_batches must be an integer >= 2, got: ", cfg$n_batches)

path_result <- wf_cfg_required(cfg, "path_result")
base_name   <- basename(path_result)
batch_dirs  <- file.path(path_result, paste0(base_name, "_b", seq_len(n_batches)))

missing_dirs <- batch_dirs[!dir.exists(batch_dirs)]
if (length(missing_dirs) > 0)
  stop("Batch directories not found:\n", paste(missing_dirs, collapse = "\n"))

cat("Config:          ", params$config, "\n")
cat("path_result:     ", path_result, "\n")
cat("n_batches:       ", n_batches, "\n")
cat("run.pos:         ", run.pos, "\n")
cat("run.neg:         ", run.neg, "\n")
cat("thres_mz_ppm:    ", thres_mz_ppm, "\n")
cat("thres_rt_min:    ", thres_rt_min, "\n")
cat("thres_cor:       ", if (is.na(thres_cor)) "disabled" else thres_cor, "\n")
cat("thres_log2ratio: ", if (is.na(thres_log2ratio)) "disabled" else thres_log2ratio,
    "(after per-sample centering)\n")
cat("best_match:      ", best_match, "\n")
cat("shift_correction:", shift_correction, "\n")

# Load each batch config and assign overlap samples to the original batch
batch_cfgs  <- lapply(seq_len(n_batches), function(i) {
  p <- file.path(batch_dirs[i], paste0("config_b", i, ".yml"))
  if (!file.exists(p)) { warning("Batch config not found: ", p); return(NULL) }
  yaml::read_yaml(p)
})
batch_metas <- lapply(batch_cfgs, function(bcfg) {
  if (is.null(bcfg)) return(NULL)
  m <- wf_as_meta_df(bcfg$meta_pos)
  if (is.null(m)) wf_as_meta_df(bcfg$meta_neg) else m
})
master_meta_pos <- wf_as_meta_df(cfg$meta_pos)
master_meta_neg <- wf_as_meta_df(cfg$meta_neg)
master_meta_for_overlap <- if (is.null(master_meta_pos)) master_meta_neg else master_meta_pos
overlap_assignment <- build_overlap_assignment(master_meta_for_overlap, batch_metas)

# Overlap assignment keyed by sample key (as found in peaktable column names)
overlap_assignment_pos <- assignment_to_keys(overlap_assignment, master_meta_pos)
overlap_assignment_neg <- assignment_to_keys(overlap_assignment, master_meta_neg)
overlap_col_assignment <- c(overlap_assignment_pos, overlap_assignment_neg)
if (length(overlap_col_assignment) > 0)
  overlap_col_assignment <- overlap_col_assignment[!duplicated(names(overlap_col_assignment))]

# Build sample to batch map
sbm_samps <- lapply(seq_along(batch_cfgs), function(i) {
  bcfg <- batch_cfgs[[i]]
  if (is.null(bcfg)) return(character(0L))
  meta_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), list(
    wf_as_meta_df(bcfg$meta_pos),
    wf_as_meta_df(bcfg$meta_neg)
  ))
  samps <- character(0L)
  for (m in meta_list) {
    if ("File.name" %in% colnames(m))
      samps <- c(samps, sub("\\.(d|mzML)$", "", make.names(m$File.name)))
    else if ("Sample" %in% colnames(m))
      samps <- c(samps, m$Sample)
  }
  unique(samps)
})
sample_batch_map <- unlist(lapply(seq_along(sbm_samps), function(i) {
  setNames(rep(i, length(sbm_samps[[i]])), sbm_samps[[i]])
}))
sample_batch_map <- c(overlap_col_assignment, sample_batch_map)
sample_batch_map <- sample_batch_map[!duplicated(names(sample_batch_map))]

cat("Overlap samples assigned to batches:", length(overlap_assignment), "\n")
cat("Total samples mapped to batches:    ", length(sample_batch_map), "\n")

```

## Feature alignment

```{r merge}

table_specs <- list(
  pos      = list(file = "peaktable_pos.xlsx",      run = run.pos, out = cfg$path_peaktable_pos),
  neg      = list(file = "peaktable_neg.xlsx",      run = run.neg, out = cfg$path_peaktable_neg),
  istd_pos = list(file = "peaktable_istd_pos.xlsx", run = run.pos, out = cfg$path_peaktable_istd_pos),
  istd_neg = list(file = "peaktable_istd_neg.xlsx", run = run.neg, out = cfg$path_peaktable_istd_neg)
)

tnames_to_run <- Filter(function(n) table_specs[[n]]$run, names(table_specs))

process_one_table <- function(tname, thres_mz_ppm = 3, thres_rt_min = 0.1, best_match = TRUE,
                              thres_cor = 0.7, thres_log2ratio = 0.3, shift_correction = TRUE,
                              shifts = NULL) {
  ts <- table_specs[[tname]]

  tables_full <- lapply(seq_along(batch_dirs), function(bi) {
    p <- file.path(batch_dirs[bi], ts$file)
    if (!file.exists(p)) return(NULL)
    openxlsx::read.xlsx(p)
  })

  n_per_batch <- vapply(tables_full, function(t) if (is.null(t)) NA_integer_ else nrow(t), integer(1))
  available   <- sum(!is.na(n_per_batch))
  if (available == 0) {
    message(tname, ": no files found — skipping")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Single pass on the full tables: overlap samples drive the quality filters, and
  # each overlap sample's values are taken from the batch it is assigned to
  res <- merge_table_list(tables_full, tname,
                          thres_mz_ppm = thres_mz_ppm, thres_rt_min = thres_rt_min,
                          best_match = best_match,
                          thres_cor = thres_cor, thres_log2ratio = thres_log2ratio,
                          shift_correction = shift_correction,
                          overlap_col_assignment = overlap_col_assignment,
                          shifts = shifts)
  if (is.null(res)) return(NULL)

  list(
    res       = res,
    available = available,
    stats = data.frame(
      Table          = tname,
      Batches_found  = available,
      Features_final = nrow(res$merged),
      Samples_final  = length(get_sample_cols(res$merged)),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  )
}

merge_args <- list(thres_mz_ppm = thres_mz_ppm, thres_rt_min = thres_rt_min,
                   best_match = best_match, thres_cor = thres_cor,
                   thres_log2ratio = thres_log2ratio, shift_correction = shift_correction)

# Main tables first; ISTD tables reuse the batch shifts estimated on the main table
# (ISTD tables have too few uniquely annotated features to estimate them)
main_names <- intersect(c("pos", "neg"), tnames_to_run)
istd_names <- intersect(c("istd_pos", "istd_neg"), tnames_to_run)

n_workers    <- min(max(1L, parallel::detectCores(logical = FALSE) - 1L), length(tnames_to_run))
use_parallel <- n_workers > 1L && length(tnames_to_run) > 1L

if (use_parallel) {
  cl <- parallel::makeCluster(n_workers)
  on.exit(parallel::stopCluster(cl), add = TRUE)
  parallel::clusterExport(cl,
    c("ppm_diff", "ccs_diff", "sample_key", "same_val", "estimate_batch_shift",
      "align_features", "clean_merged", "merge_table_list",
      "table_specs", "batch_dirs", "remove_dup", "get_sample_cols",
      "overlap_col_assignment", "process_one_table"),
    envir = environment()
  )
  parallel::clusterEvalQ(cl, library(openxlsx))
}

run_tables <- function(tnames, shifts_by_table = NULL) {
  if (length(tnames) == 0) return(list())
  if (use_parallel && length(tnames) > 1L) {
    out <- parallel::clusterMap(cl, function(tn, sh, args) do.call(process_one_table, c(list(tn, shifts = sh), args)),
                                tnames, if (is.null(shifts_by_table)) list(NULL) else shifts_by_table,
                                MoreArgs = list(args = merge_args), SIMPLIFY = FALSE)
  } else {
    out <- lapply(seq_along(tnames), function(i) {
      do.call(process_one_table, c(list(tnames[i], shifts = shifts_by_table[[i]]), merge_args))
    })
  }
  setNames(out, tnames)
}

main_res <- run_tables(main_names)
istd_shifts <- lapply(istd_names, function(n) {
  r <- main_res[[sub("^istd_", "", n)]]
  if (is.null(r)) NULL else r$res$shifts
})
all_res_list <- c(main_res, run_tables(istd_names, istd_shifts))[tnames_to_run]
names(all_res_list) <- tnames_to_run

results    <- list()
diag_data  <- list()
stats_rows <- list()
for (tname in tnames_to_run) {
  r <- all_res_list[[tname]]
  if (is.null(r)) next
  results[[tname]]    <- r$res$merged
  diag_data[[tname]]  <- r$res
  stats_rows[[tname]] <- r$stats
}

```

### Matching funnel

Number of reference features retained at each filter, per merge step. `shift_ppm` / `shift_rt`
are the estimated systematic offsets of the batch relative to b1 (from `anchors` uniquely
annotated features), removed before matching.

```{r funnel}

funnel_df <- do.call(rbind, Filter(Negate(is.null), lapply(diag_data, `[[`, "funnel")))
if (!is.null(funnel_df) && nrow(funnel_df) > 0) {
  rownames(funnel_df) <- NULL
  knitr::kable(funnel_df, caption = "Features retained per filter step")
}

```

## Output

```{r write_output}

if (!dir.exists(path_result)) dir.create(path_result, recursive = TRUE)

for (tname in names(results)) {
  out_path <- table_specs[[tname]]$out
  if (wf_is_blank(out_path)) {
    warning("Output path not set in config for ", tname, " — skipping")
    next
  }
  wf_ensure_parent_dirs(out_path)
  openxlsx::write.xlsx(results[[tname]], out_path, overwrite = TRUE)
  message("Wrote: ", out_path)
}

# Save diagnostics for evaluate_merge
if (length(diag_data) > 0) {
  all_diag_list   <- Filter(Negate(is.null), lapply(diag_data, `[[`, "diag"))
  all_counts_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), lapply(diag_data, `[[`, "counts"))
  all_funnel_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), lapply(diag_data, `[[`, "funnel"))
  all_l2r_list    <- Filter(function(x) !is.null(x) && nrow(x) > 0,
                            lapply(diag_data, `[[`, "l2r_long"))
  all_ic_list     <- Filter(Negate(is.null), lapply(diag_data, `[[`, "input_counts"))

  bind_fill <- function(lst) {
    if (length(lst) == 0) return(NULL)
    cols <- unique(unlist(lapply(lst, colnames)))
    do.call(rbind, lapply(lst, function(d) { d[setdiff(cols, colnames(d))] <- NA; d[cols] }))
  }

  merge_diag <- list(
    all_diag         = bind_fill(all_diag_list),
    all_counts       = if (length(all_counts_list) > 0) do.call(rbind, all_counts_list) else NULL,
    all_funnel       = if (length(all_funnel_list) > 0) do.call(rbind, all_funnel_list) else NULL,
    all_l2r          = if (length(all_l2r_list)    > 0) do.call(rbind, all_l2r_list)    else NULL,
    all_input_counts = if (length(all_ic_list)     > 0) do.call(rbind, all_ic_list)     else NULL,
    n_final          = vapply(diag_data, function(x) x$n_final, integer(1)),
    sample_batch_map = sample_batch_map
  )
  diag_path <- file.path(path_result, "data", "merge_diagnostics.rds")
  dir.create(dirname(diag_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  saveRDS(merge_diag, diag_path)
  message("Wrote diagnostics: ", diag_path)
}

if (length(stats_rows) > 0) {
  stats_df <- do.call(rbind, stats_rows)
  knitr::kable(
    stats_df,
    caption = "Merge summary",
    col.names = c("Table", "Batches merged", "Features (final)", "Samples (final)")
  )
}
```
